description: Hong Kong Observatory open data is a data repository run by Hong Kong Observatory. The page describes the open data feeds of the observatory: current weather, forecasts, warnings, tropical cyclone tracks, earthquake and tsunami messages, and historical climate and tide data, offered as APIs and files through DATA.GOV.HK. Coverage: Hong Kong. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as json, csv; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("Hong Kong Observatory Open Data｜Hong Kong Observatory(HKO)｜e-Services") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support weather and hazard inputs for Hong Kong infrastructure studies. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
